prompt: The cute baby dragon walks cheerfully in place, like on a treadmill, with a bouncy happy walk cycle: its little legs step one after the other, its body bobs up and down with each step, the wooden stick on its shoulder and the red checked bundle tied to it bounce gently, its tail sways and its wings flutter a little. It keeps facing the same way and stays in exactly the same spot and size in the frame; it does not move across the screen. Soft flat 2D cartoon style exactly like the image, same colours and proportions. The camera is completely locked, no zoom, no pan. The background stays one flat solid green the whole time. No new objects, no text, no shadows. Ends in exactly the starting pose so the walk loops seamlessly.
